mapper.select: SELECT F.SEQ, F.FILE_ID, F.ORIGINAL_NAME, F.STORED_NAME, F.FILE_PATH, F.FILE_EXTENSION, F.FILE_SIZE, F.MIME_TYPE FROM TB_BOARD_FILE BF INNER JOIN TB_FILE F ON BF.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID WHERE BF.BOARD_SEQ = #{boardSeq} AND BF.DELETED = 0 AND F.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY BF.ORDER_NUM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BOARD_FILE ( BOARD_SEQ, FILE_ID, ORDER_NUM, CREATE_DATETIME ) VALUES ( #{boardSeq}, #{fileId}, #{orderNum}, NOW() )
